snippet.title: Farr: Shahnameh Card Battle
snippet.description:
Who will win the Farr?

A thousand years ago, the poet Ferdowsi wrote the Shahnameh, the Persian Book of Kings. Now its heroes march again, and you lead them.

Farr is a real-time strategy card game set in the world of the Shahnameh. Build a deck of eight cards, an army of legendary heroes and mythical creatures, send your army into the field and break the enemy fortress before the clock runs out. Every battle is short, every decision counts, and every win brings you closer to the legends.

THREE-MINUTE BATTLES, REAL TACTICS
Matches are fast and easy to start, but deep to master. Place your units, defend your towers and strike at the right moment. Every card has a cost, so timing, placement and the cards you hold back decide who wins. Cavalry crushes infantry, divs shrug off swords, archers punish slow armies: learn the counters and turn a losing fight around.

HEROES OF THE SHAHNAMEH
Command the champions of Ferdowsi's epic:
- Rostam, the world champion, and his loyal horse Rakhsh
- Sohrab, Rostam's young son
- Esfandiyar, the brazen-bodied prince
- Siavash, the innocent prince of Persia
- Zal, raised by the Simorgh
- Arash the Archer, whose arrow marked the border of Persia and Turan
- Kaveh the Blacksmith, who rose against a tyrant
- Kay Khosrow, the just king
Call on the Simorgh, and stand against Zahhak, the White Div, the armies of Turan and the creatures of Mazandaran.

COLLECT, UPGRADE, EXPERIMENT
Collect heroes, soldiers, spells and creatures, each painted in a Persian miniature-inspired style. Upgrade your cards, build several armies for different plans, and swap them in before each fight. Every card comes with its own story from the Shahnameh, and you can read it in the Shahnameh Recital.

STORY CAMPAIGN: THE SHAHNAMEH PASS
Fight through the epic chapter by chapter, starting with Kayumars, the first king of the world. Each stage retells a moment of the Shahnameh, and each victory unlocks the next part of the tale and new rewards.

RISE THROUGH LEGENDARY ARENAS
Win battles, earn trophies and climb through twelve arenas: from the Opening Field to the Battle Plain, Mount Alborz, Mazandaran, the Land of Turan, Mount Damavand and all the way to the Kayanian Throne. Each arena unlocks new cards and new challenges.

FERDOWSI, YOUR NARRATOR
Ferdowsi, the poet of the Shahnameh, is your guide as a character in the game. He narrates the tutorial, recites the verses of the Shahnameh for your cards, and shares tips on the home screen. You can even chat with an AI-powered Ferdowsi about the Shahnameh, its heroes and its stories. His answers are generated by AI and may contain mistakes, and every answer can be reported from the chat.

CLANS AND CLAN WARS
Add friends with a friend code or QR code and challenge them to friendly battles. Join a clan, chat with your clan mates and fight together in clan wars for the glory of your banner.

DAILY QUESTS AND EVENTS
Complete daily quests, take on the Seven Labours, compete in the Kay Khosrow Cup and Jam-e Jam and visit the Bazaar for limited cards. There is always a new goal waiting.

A WORLD OF PERSIAN LEGEND
Farr is made by a small team that loves the Shahnameh. The art, the music and the stories all come from Persian tradition, so every battle is also a page of one of the world's great epics.

FREE TO PLAY
Farr is free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases of Gems are available through Google Play. Some items, such as chests and card packs, contain random rewards. You can require authentication for purchases in your Google Play settings. An internet connection is required to play.

Privacy policy: https://global.faargame.ir/en/privacy
Support and feedback: youshgamestudio@gmail.com, or Settings Support & feedback in the game.

Raise your sword, build your army: the Farr is yours to win!
